aka.zh: 红格公路（原 215 国道，红柳园—格尔木）

tagline.en: A 641 km desert road across the Qaidam, stretched in 2013 from the Mongolian border at Mazongshan through Yushu and western Sichuan to Ning'er in southern Yunnan
tagline.zh: 原本是横穿柴达木的 641 公里戈壁公路，2013 年被延长为自中蒙边境马鬃山经玉树、川西直抵滇南宁洱的南北纵线

start.en: Mazongshan border crossing, Mazongshan town, Subei county, Jiuquan, Gansu, on the Mongolian border
start.zh: 甘肃省酒泉市肃北蒙古族自治县马鬃山镇马鬃山口岸（中蒙边境）

end.zh: 云南省普洱市宁洱哈尼族彝族自治县

en: Under the national highway plan of June 2013, G215 is one of the north–south national highways, running from the Mazongshan border crossing on the Mongolian frontier in Gansu to Ning'er in southern Yunnan. The plan's control points are Mazongshan, Guazhou, Dunhuang, Aksay, Lenghu, Golmud, Qumarlêb, Zhidoi, Yushu, Dêgê, Baiyü, Batang, Dêrong, Weixi, Lanping, Yunlong, Dali, Weishan, Nanjian, Jingdong, Zhenyuan, Jinggu and Ning'er: across the Hexi corridor and the Qaidam basin, over the Qinghai plateau to Yushu, down the western edge of Sichuan's Garzê prefecture, and through north-western and southern Yunnan. The 2022 plan kept the same line and the same ends. No official length for the whole route has been found.

Before 2013 the number meant something much shorter: the road from Liuyuan in Gansu to Golmud in Qinghai, 641 km, known as the Hongliuyuan–Golmud road, across the Dangjin Pass and through the Qaidam by Da Qaidam and the Qarhan salt lake. The 2013 plan extended it at both ends and moved its Qaidam line west through Lenghu. The atlas draws G215 as one long piece from Mazongshan to Ning'er, to which this profile is attached, and two short fragments in Qinghai.
zh: 按 2013 年 6 月公布的《国家公路网规划（2013年—2030年）》，G215 是普通国道北南纵线之一，自甘肃中蒙边境的马鬃山口岸至云南南部的宁洱。规划所列主要控制点为马鬃山（口岸）、瓜州、敦煌、阿克塞、冷湖、格尔木、曲麻莱、治多、玉树、德格、白玉、巴塘、得荣、维西、兰坪、云龙、大理、巍山、南涧、景东、镇沅、景谷、宁洱：穿河西走廊西端和柴达木盆地，越青海高原至玉树，沿四川甘孜州西缘南下，再纵贯滇西北和滇南。2022 年的新版规划保留了这条线和起讫点。未查到全线的官方里程。
2013 年以前，这个编号所指的路要短得多：自甘肃柳园至青海格尔木，全长 641 公里，即“红格公路”，翻当金山口，经大柴旦、察尔汗盐湖穿过柴达木。2013 年的规划把它向两端延长，并把柴达木一段西移经冷湖。本图集把 G215 绘为自马鬃山至宁洱的一长段（本条目即挂在这一段上），另有两段青海境内的短碎片。

en: In the Qaidam the problem is salt. The 80.052 km expressway built on the G215 line from Qarhan to Golmud runs over saline soil for 99% of its length; its surveyors describe geotextile and geogrid layers, gravel barrier courses and corrosion-resistant concrete piles across the salt lake, measures they call the first of their kind in China. In the Gansu gobi the problem is water: on the Mazongshan–Qiaowan road, where the ground water is alkaline, the contractor desalinated water by reverse osmosis to cure the cement-stabilised base.

South of Yushu the standard drops sharply. Qinghai's transport department gives the Qumahe–Qumarlêb stretch as a class-II road for 60 km/h and the Zhidoi–Yushu stretch for 80 or 60 km/h, falling to 40 km/h over the Haxiu mountain. In Sichuan the rebuilt northern sections are class-III roads: Luoxu in Shiqu to Kelodong in Dêgê, about 120 km, for 30 km/h on a 7.5 m roadbed with a tunnel under the Pengcuo Sangduo mountain; Baiyü to Batang, about 190.3 km, for 30 km/h and 40 km/h through the two towns. The Dêrong section, 70.8 km, is a class-II road for 40 km/h with the 2,298 m Dêrong No. 1 tunnel. In Yunnan the 87.31 km from Weixi to Tongdian in Lanping is a class-II road for 40 to 60 km/h, with six tunnels totalling 3,194 m and 106 bridges.
zh: 在柴达木，难题是盐。沿 G215 修建的察尔汗至格尔木高速公路全长 80.052 公里，盐渍土占线路长度的 99%；勘察单位称，盐湖路段采用了铺设土工布、土工格栅、设置砂砾隔断层、使用布袋桩防腐高强混凝土等措施，均为国内首创。在甘肃戈壁，难题是水：马鬃山至桥湾公路沿线地下水含碱量高，施工单位用反渗透净水脱盐设备制水，来养生水泥稳定基层。

玉树以南，技术标准明显降低。青海省交通运输厅给出：曲麻河乡至曲麻莱段为设计速度 60 公里/小时的二级公路，治多至玉树段一般路段 80（60）公里/小时，越岭的哈秀山段 40 公里/小时。四川北部的改建路段为三级公路：石渠洛须至德格柯洛洞段约 120 公里，设计速度 30 公里/小时，路基宽 7.5 米，以隧道穿越彭措桑多山；白玉至巴塘段约 190.3 公里，设计速度 30 公里/小时，两县城过境段 40 公里/小时。得荣段 70.8 公里为设计速度 40 公里/小时的二级公路，含全长 2298 米的得荣 1 号隧道。云南境内，维西至兰坪通甸段 87.31 公里为二级公路，设计时速 40 至 60 公里，共有隧道 6 座总长 3194 米、桥梁 106 座。

en: The original road is old but its record is thin. A secondary account, a Sohu travel feature apparently drawing on a Qinghai road record, says the Qinghai section was finished as a basic road in November 1954, listed as a national highway in November 1981 under the name Liuyuan–Golmud road, and renamed the Hongliuyuan–Golmud road after the second national road census of 2000; this has not been checked against an official history. In 2009 Qinghai's transport department described G215 as running from Liuyuan in Anxi county by Dunhuang, Aksay, Huahaizi, Da Qaidam and the Qarhan salt lake to Golmud, a link between G109, G312 and G315 and a main road of the Qaidam's mineral industry.

Qinghai rebuilt its part from 2008. A new Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam road, 194.263 km, mostly class I, was begun on 15 June 2008 and opened on 1 January 2010. The province then built the corridor as a divided expressway, one carriageway at a time: Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam (178.99 km) and Da Qaidam–Qarhan (146.8 km), were begun in autumn 2009; the first carriageway of Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam opened on 20 June 2010, and both sections passed handover inspection in January 2012. Gansu's expressway from Dunhuang to the Dangjin Pass, opened on 29 April 2022 as part of the G3011 Liuyuan–Golmud expressway, joins the Qinghai expressway at the pass.

The 2013 plan turned the desert road into a 23-point line. In the north Gansu built Mazongshan–Qiaowan, 157.24 km, between the G7 and G30 expressways, begun on 8 September 2019 and opened on 20 September 2022, and a G215 expressway from Liuyuan to Dunhuang, 117.257 km, opened on 1 July 2020. In Qinghai the line south from Golmud to Yushu took over provincial road S308 from Yushu by Qumarlêb, which Qinghai planned to start rebuilding as a class-II road in June 2013, and a new class-II road from Sebei to Qarhan was announced in 2017. In Sichuan, Dêrong became, on 26 September 2019, the last county in the province to be reached by a national highway; the Baiyü–Batang section was handed over in May 2024. In Yunnan the Weixi section of the Weixi–Tongdian road opened for trial running in November 2020.
zh: 原来的这条路历史不短，但记载很少。一篇搜狐旅行文章（看来引自青海的公路志书）称：青海段原路于 1954 年 11 月建成简易公路，1981 年 11 月列入国道，改称柳格公路，2000 年第二次全国公路普查时复名红格公路；此说未与官方史料核对。2009 年，青海省交通厅称国道 215 线起自甘肃省安西县柳园镇，经敦煌、阿克塞、花海子、大柴旦、察尔汗盐湖至格尔木，把 109、312、315 国道连接起来，是柴达木资源开发的重要干线。

青海自 2008 年起重修境内路段。新建的当金山至大柴旦公路全长 194.263 公里，大部分按一级公路标准，2008 年 6 月 15 日开工，2010 年 1 月 1 日放行车辆。此后青海按分离式高速公路标准、先建一幅再建另一幅的方式改造这一通道：当金山至大柴旦（178.99 公里）、大柴旦至察尔汗（146.8 公里）两段于 2009 年秋开工；当金山至大柴旦段于 2010 年 6 月 20 日单幅开通，两段于 2012 年 1 月通过交工验收。甘肃的敦煌至当金山口高速公路作为 G3011 柳格高速的一部分，于 2022 年 4 月 29 日通车，在当金山与青海的高速公路相接。

2013 年的规划把这条戈壁公路变成了一条有 23 个控制点的纵线。北端，甘肃修建了连接 G7 与 G30 两条高速公路的马鬃山至桥湾公路，全长 157.24 公里，2019 年 9 月 8 日开工，2022 年 9 月 20 日通车；又修建了 G215 柳园至敦煌高速公路，全长 117.257 公里，2020 年 7 月 1 日通车。青海境内，格尔木以南至玉树的路线接管了玉树经曲麻莱的省道 308 线，青海原计划于 2013 年 6 月按二级公路标准开工改建；2017 年又宣布新建涩北至察尔汗二级公路。四川境内，2019 年 9 月 26 日，得荣县成为全省最后一个通国道的县；白玉至巴塘段于 2024 年 5 月交工验收。云南境内，维西至兰坪通甸公路维西段于 2020 年 11 月通车试运行。

en: No cost has been published for the original road or for the 2013 route, which is being built and rebuilt project by project in four provinces. The project figures that are public show three ways of paying. In Sichuan the provincial approvals set out the split: of the ¥2.17 billion estimated for Luoxu–Kelodong, about ¥1.595 billion was to come from the central vehicle purchase tax fund, and of ¥2.82 billion for Baiyü–Batang, about ¥2.304 billion, with Garzê prefecture raising the rest.

In Gansu the new roads were built with private capital. Liuyuan–Dunhuang, budgeted at ¥4.95 billion, was a public–private partnership: ¥1.485 billion of equity, of which ¥510 million from the government and ¥975 million from five companies, and about ¥3.46 billion raised by the project company through bank loans, with a 30-year toll period. Mazongshan–Qiaowan, ¥4.44 billion, was built under an entrust–build–operate arrangement between Jiuquan and a provincial construction group. In Qinghai the Qaidam expressway sections were provincial projects: ¥1.124 billion for Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam and ¥1.661 billion for Da Qaidam–Qarhan.
zh: 无论原来的红格公路还是 2013 年规划的全线，都没有公布过总造价；全线由四省分项目新建、改建。已公开的项目数字显示了三种出资方式。四川的立项批复写明了构成：石渠洛须至德格柯洛洞段估算总投资约 21.7 亿元，其中拟安排中央车购税资金约 15.95 亿元；白玉至巴塘段约 28.2 亿元，其中车购税资金约 23.04 亿元，其余由甘孜州自筹。

甘肃的新路引入了社会资本。柳园至敦煌公路概算总投资 49.5 亿元，采用政府和社会资本合作（PPP）模式：项目资本金 14.85 亿元，其中政府资本金 5.1 亿元、五家企业社会资本金 9.75 亿元，其余约 34.64 亿元由项目公司通过银行贷款等方式筹集，收费期限 30 年。马鬃山至桥湾公路总投资 44.4 亿元，由酒泉市与省公交建集团以“委托—建设—运营”（EBO）模式合作建设。青海柴达木的高速公路路段为省属项目：当金山至大柴旦工程投资 11.2365 亿元，大柴旦至察尔汗 16.61 亿元。

en: The northern end is fast: Mazongshan–Qiaowan is a four-lane class-I road for 80 km/h, and Liuyuan–Dunhuang is a tolled expressway for 80 km/h. South of Golmud the road climbs onto the Qinghai plateau; the Qinghai transport department numbers the Qumahe end of the Qumarlêb section at kilometre 1,541 and Yushu at about kilometre 1,925. Between Luoxu and Batang in western Sichuan the rebuilt road is class III, built for 30 km/h.
zh: 北端路况好：马鬃山至桥湾为双向四车道一级公路，设计速度 80 公里/小时；柳园至敦煌为收费高速公路，设计速度 80 公里/小时。格尔木以南，路线登上青海高原；青海省交通运输厅的桩号显示，曲麻河乡在 K1541 附近，玉树在 K1925 附近。川西洛须至巴塘之间，改建后的路段为三级公路，设计速度 30 公里/小时。

why.en: No cost has been published for the original Hongliuyuan–Golmud road or for the route planned in 2013, which four provinces are building and rebuilding project by project. Sourced project figures are listed below.
why.zh: 原红格公路和 2013 年规划的全线均未公布造价；全线由四省分项目新建、改建。有来源的项目数字分列于下。

why.en: No route-wide statement exists. Sourced project funding: Sichuan sections mainly from the central vehicle purchase tax fund with the rest from Garzê prefecture; Liuyuan–Dunhuang as a public–private partnership repaid from tolls; Mazongshan–Qiaowan under an entrust–build–operate arrangement. The figures are given in the money section and below.
why.zh: 未见全线出资说明。已查到的项目出资：四川各段以中央车购税资金为主、其余由甘孜州自筹；柳园至敦煌段采用 PPP 模式、以通行费偿还；马鬃山至桥湾段采用 EBO 模式。具体数字见造价一节及下列各项。

timeline.en: The Qinghai section of the Liuyuan–Golmud road is finished as a basic road in November, by a secondary account.
timeline.zh: 据二手资料，11 月，柳格公路青海段建成简易公路。

timeline.en: The road is listed as a national highway in November, by the same account.
timeline.zh: 据同一资料，11 月，该路列入国道。

timeline.en: Work starts on a new Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam road on 15 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 15 日，当金山至大柴旦公路开工。

timeline.en: The new Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam road opens on 1 January; the first expressway carriageways open on 20 June.
timeline.zh: 1 月 1 日，当大公路放行车辆；6 月 20 日，高速公路单幅开通。

timeline.en: The Dangjin Pass–Da Qaidam and Da Qaidam–Qarhan expressways pass handover inspection in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，当金山至大柴旦、大柴旦至察尔汗高速公路通过交工验收。

timeline.en: The national highway plan of June extends G215 to Mazongshan and Ning'er, by way of Lenghu and Yushu.
timeline.zh: 6 月公布的《国家公路网规划》将 G215 经冷湖、玉树延至马鬃山和宁洱。

timeline.en: Work starts on Mazongshan–Qiaowan on 8 September; on 26 September Dêrong becomes the last county in Sichuan reached by a national highway.
timeline.zh: 9 月 8 日，马鬃山至桥湾公路开工；9 月 26 日，得荣县成为四川最后一个通国道的县。

timeline.en: The Liuyuan–Dunhuang expressway opens on 1 July; the Weixi section in Yunnan opens for trial running in November.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，柳园至敦煌高速公路通车；11 月，云南维西段通车试运行。

timeline.en: Mazongshan–Qiaowan opens on 20 September; the new national highway plan keeps G215 as Mazongshan–Ning'er.
timeline.zh: 9 月 20 日，马鬃山至桥湾公路通车；新版《国家公路网规划》保留 G215 马鬃山—宁洱线。

timeline.en: The rebuilt Baiyü–Batang section in Sichuan is handed over on 29 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 29 日，四川白玉至巴塘段改建工程交工验收。
